result.brief: 系统梳理生成式世界模型（潜动力学、视频生成、联合嵌入预测）在八项模拟器能力上的进展与差距，指出状态反馈、长时稳定与形式化物理等六个研究方向。
result.reason: Survey of generative world models (latent dynamics, video generation, JEPA-style prediction) mapping 200 works onto simulator capabilities; directly informs video/multimodal world model research agenda.
